threads.body: [Testing] Weaver 0.27.0 changed the `--output=http` protocol: `POST /stop` no longer returns the report. The existing `stop()` implementation still parses that response body as the report, so `afterEach()` will fail instead of validating the collected metrics. Update the lifecycle to call `POST /stop`, read the report with `GET /report`, and then call `POST /shutdown` before stopping the container (or retain 0.26.1 until that adaptation is made).
